record.original_question: Let n be a positive integer, and let A1, ..., An be self-adjoint real n x n matrices with spectral norms bounded by 1 (that is, ||Ai|| <= 1 for every i). Does there exist a universal constant C > 0 such that one can always choose signs epsilon1, ..., epsilonn in {+1, -1} so that the operator norm of the signed sum is bounded by C*sqrt(n): ||sum_{i=1}^n epsiloni Ai|| <= C*sqrt(n)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 1 (Matrix Spencer). There exists a positive universal constant C such that, for all positive integers n, and all choices of n self-adjoint n×n real matrices A1, . . . , An satisfying, for all i ∈ [n], ∥Ai∥ ≤ 1 (where ∥ · ∥ denotes the spectral norm) the following holds min_{ε∈{±1}} ||sum_{i=1}^n εiAi|| ≤ C√n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\|\cdot\|$ denote the spectral (operator) norm on real $n\times n$ matrices. Determine whether there exists a universal constant $C>0$ with the following property: for every positive integer $n$ and every choice of self-adjoint real $n\times n$ matrices $A_1,\dots,A_n$ satisfying $\|A_i\|\le 1$ for all $i\in\{1,\dots,n\}$, there exist signs $\varepsilon_1,\dots,\varepsilon_n\in\{+1,-1\}$ such that
$$\Big\|\sum_{i=1}^n \varepsilon_i A_i\Big\| \le C\sqrt{n}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The Matrix Spencer conjecture remains open in full generality. Bansal, Jiang, and Meka (STOC 2023) resolved it for matrices of rank at most $n/\log^3 n$, and related partial results exist, but the general case for arbitrary self-adjoint matrices with bounded spectral norm is still unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Resolving Matrix Spencer Conjecture Up to Poly-logarithmic Rank
status_evidence.snippet: We show that for symmetric d x d matrices A_1,...,A_n with ||A_i|| <= 1 and rank at most n/log^3 n, one can efficiently find signs achieving spectral norm O(sqrt(n)).
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is proved only in a restricted (low-rank) regime, indicating the general case remains open.

status_evidence.title: Matrix Spencer Problem Overview
status_evidence.snippet: Recent advances have nearly resolved the conjecture for broad regimes... the full general case without rank constraints remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The Matrix Spencer conjecture is still an open problem.
